Improved_Prompt: Act as a biology tutor. Explain photosynthesis for a Grade 8 student in 120 words. Include sunlight, chlorophyll, carbon dioxide and water. Give one example.
Act as a communication assistant. Draft a polite email to a project manager requesting a two-day report extension. Include a subject and keep the body under 120 words.
Act as a Python mentor. Review the supplied function, identify the IndexError, provide corrected code and explain the fix in three bullet points.
Act as a research assistant. Summarize the supplied report for a college student in five bullet points. Preserve key facts and do not add unsupported information.
Act as an algorithms instructor. Compare merge sort and bubble sort in a table using time complexity, space complexity, stability and use cases.
